fields.asset_name: EcoPro BM Debrecen CAM plant
fields.offtakers: Samsung SDI (reported elsewhere, not confirmed here)

rows.notes: 54,000 t/yr = three lines, started Nov-Dec 2025 (electrive) with commercial ramp in 2026 (start_year 2026 per Korea Herald/Korea Times coverage; the sources differ on commercial start timing). Further 54,000 t (to 108,000 t, 'three additional lines') is demand-contingent and undated (S3 'depending on customer demand') so excluded from capacity per undated-aspiration rule; site land could host 12 lines (200 kt) per dealsite 2024-11-07 (not used). Coordinates not given in sources. [lead] confidence capped at 0.5: key field rests on reported evidence.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro BM Ochang CAM plants (5 plants)

rows.notes: Five plants at Ochang aggregated into one row (source gives only the combined 30,000 t/yr). capacity_ref_year 2023 from the same article's 'as of 2023' total; publication Feb 2024. Per-plant split not found. [lead] confidence capped at 0.5: key field rests on reported evidence.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro BM Pohang CAM plants (excl. CAM7 JV and CAM9) - residual

rows.notes: DERIVED value: 150,000 t Pohang total as of 2023 (S4) minus 54,000 t CAM7 (S5; EcoPro EM JV row) = 96,000 t. Assumes the 150,000 t figure includes the JV CAM7 plant (a 2020 article describes the 150 -> 180 kt target as 'including the JV' but this is not re-confirmed). If CAM7 is excluded from the 150 kt, capacity here is 150,000. Per-plant (CAM1-6, CAM8) capacities not found in open sources. 2026 reports of ~160 kt Pohang at end-2025 and ~240 kt total (a broker research note via search snippet only) were not opened and are not used.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro EM Pohang CAM7

rows.notes: EcoPro BM + Samsung SDI JV (EcoPro EM; electrive 2020 text gives 60/40 EcoPro BM/Samsung SDI but this was not in a copied quote). Construction completion announced 21 Oct 2022, operation planned from Q1 2023 (per the Korea Times summary); no later article confirming commercial output was opened, so status 'operational' rests on the 2023 aggregate in S4. Capacity ref year 2022 = publication year.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro BM Pohang CAM9

rows.notes: Source (Nov 2024) says completion target moved from end-2024 to end-2026; current (Nov 2026) status not re-confirmed, so under_construction is the Nov 2024 state. Capacity ref year 2026 = stated completion year.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro Pohang Blue Valley campus (planned)

rows.notes: 2 trillion won, 694,214 sqm site, completion 2028 (2023 article). The article's 710,000 t/yr figure is the EcoPro group-wide 2027 target including Blue Valley (other 2024 coverage), not a Blue Valley-only capacity, so capacity is left null. Dated 2023; later EcoPro reports (Nov 2024) say the 710 kt target slipped to 2030. Status not re-verified.

fields.asset_name: EcoPro CAM Canada Becancour
fields.jv_partners: SK On, Ford (planned shareholders per 2023 announcement; Ford reported to have exited, not confirmed)

rows.notes: 45,000 t/yr CAM (S16). Construction began Aug 2023; paused April 2024, resumed, then standstill since 5 Aug 2024 for redesign; start target pushed from 1H 2026 to 2027 (S17, Korea Herald, paraphrase = reported tier). Nov 2025 Korean press says Quebec plant is 'still being pursued' (kbmaeil, no capacity/timing). Current 2026 construction status not found; project_state paused is the latest evidence. One search-result summary said Ford withdrew - not confirmed by a page I opened. Capacity ref year 2027 = pushed start target (not a confirmed phase date).

fields.asset_name: POSCO Future M Gwangyang CAM plant (existing)

rows.notes: 90,000 t/yr stated in 2023 (KED, asiae). First US shipment from the Gwangyang cathode plant on 26 July (2025; S12). The additional 52,500 t NCA plant is a separate row. Whether the 2023 90 kt figure is unchanged at end-2025 was not confirmed (POSCO Future M annual report/DART not accessible).

fields.asset_name: POSCO Future M Gwangyang NCA single-crystal plant (Yulchon 1st Industrial Complex)

fields.asset_name: POSCO Future M Pohang (Yeongilman) high-nickel CAM plants (phases 1, 2, 2-2)

rows.notes: Plan (Apr 2023): phase 1 30,000 t (1st plant, construction started Apr 2023), phase 2 30,000 t, phase 2-2 46,000 t (completion 2025) = 106,000 t (S8, S9; phase split from search snippets/KED, not copied as a quote). Status operational only because S12 says production at the Pohang cathode plant is being expanded; the installed amount and which phases run is not known. Part of Pohang NCM lines is to be converted to LFP (see LFP row); that conversion could reduce NCM capacity.

fields.asset_name: Ultium CAM Becancour (POSCO Future M - GM)

rows.notes: CONFLICT on capacity: Korea Herald (S15, reported) phase 1 = 20,000 t with phase 2 to 33,000 t CAM; electrive Oct 2025 and POSCO Future M 2023 release say 30,000 t. fields.asset_name: Sumitomo Metal Mining Niihama/Besshi NCA cathode plant

rows.notes: Capacity 84,000 t/yr = 7,000 t/month x 12 from the July 2021 plan (output to rise from about 5,000 to about 7,000 t/month in 2025; a further target of 10,000 t/month by 2027 was also stated and is not used here because later status is unknown). Integrated Report 2026 (p.43-44) confirms Niihama Plant Line 1 producing NCA, Line 2 in trials for High-Ni NMC, planned to be sold after FY2027, and shows NCA output of roughly 4,000-5,000 t/month in a bar chart (values not readable as text, not used). Production NCA 'reached a record high' in FY2025 per the same report. Isoura plant makes precursor and nickel sulphate, not CAM (other task). Sumiko Energy Materials Co. (SEMCO) appears in the SMM supply-chain chart as a battery-materials site; no capacity found.

fields.asset_name: Nichia Anan (Tatsumi/Niino) cathode materials

Which plant makes the cathode and the capacity are not disclosed in anything opened; chemistry (LCO) is not stated in the quotes. Row is a placeholder for an existing producer.

fields.asset_name: L&F Plus Daegu LFP plant (Guji, Phase 2 complex)

rows.notes: Built in about nine months from Aug 2025, 338.2 bn won; 30,000 t/yr running, 60,000 t/yr by 1H 2027 (two more lines). Further expansion to 120,000 t is 'under review' (Korea Times Nov 2026: 120,000 t by 2H 2028) - undated aspiration, excluded. Some May 2026 articles say mass production starts end-Q3 2026; Nov 2026 articles say 30 kt is current capacity. Status operational from S27 (first commercial LFP plant outside China) and S26 ('currently operates at 30,000 tons').
